## Ravenfield VR (next, after 1.16.8)

- Pulling a bolt or a magazine no longer plays a gun's whole reload sound: mods that keep their reload in one long clip are cut at each action.
- The QJB201 family's feed cover opens: the hand was moving a small latch, and the cover stayed shut. The latch now turns with it.
- A short feed cover lifts from anywhere on it.
- Opening and shutting the cover on a loaded machine gun keeps the belt; only a changed box needs its belt laid.
- An empty box under an open cover says BOX EMPTY instead of asking for a belt.
- With belt laying by hand off, a box put in under an open cover shows its belt.
- The AS Val's bolt can be pulled: the mod never saw it move, and racked an invisible handle.
- An enemy's gun whose magazine you pulled has no magazine in it when you pick it up.
- Holding the trigger to leave a seat no longer fires the gun as it comes up.
- The QJB201 family weighs and swings as the long guns they are, and the whole handguard can be held.
- A double barrel you drop keeps its fired cases and stays open if it was.
- A magazine in the hand falls when you die instead of staying there into the next life.
